PLATFORM AND ECOSYSTEM | G1-G3 with G6 anchors
[I] Bet: control the core; let partners extend merchant value.
Time: FY2018-FY2025 evidence; no supplied 2026 observations.
|
|-- Core platform and extensibility
|   |-- [S] BFCM 2023: 967,000 requests/second at peak.
|   `-- [S] Mid-2024 Edition: unification; 150+ updates.
|
|-- App ecosystem
|   |-- [R] Apps: ~2,500 (2018) -> >21,000 (2025).
|   |-- [S] Built for Shopify launched 2023; >675 apps at FY2024.
|   `-- [I] App count alone cannot establish app quality.
|
|-- Developer economics: 2021 revenue-share cut
|   |-- [R] Zero share on first $1M of annual app/theme developer earnings.
|   |-- [S] Q3 2021 revenue impact: about -$11M.
|   `-- Cut -[D:assoc]-> developer activity; no causal estimate.
|
|-- Partners and referrals
|   |-- [R] Referrers: ~18,000 (2018) -> >40,000 (2021).
|   |-- Partners -[D:claim]-> merchant growth.
|   `-- Merchant growth -[D:claim]-> more partners.
|
|-- Enterprise and systems partners
|   |-- [S] Systems integrators refer business; Oracle deal in 2024.
|   `-- Integrators -[D:claim]-> enterprise adoption.
|
|-- Commerce partners on Shopify's rails
|   |-- [S] Amazon / Adyen (2023); PayPal / Klarna (2024).
|   |-- [S] Roblox, YouTube Shopping, Perplexity moves in 2024.
|   `-- [I] Build-versus-partner choices differ across capabilities.
|
|-- Strategic stakes and partnership economics
|   |-- [R] Affirm / Global-E stakes began as non-cash consideration.
|   |-- [R] FY2025 values: Affirm $1,511M; Global-E $868M; Klaviyo $599M.
|   |-- Stakes -[D:claim]-> strategic alignment and value.
|   |-- [R] Non-cash revenue: $158M (FY2023) -> $49M (FY2025).
|   `-- [R] Flexport has both an equity-method stake and separate notes.
|
`-- Reading earnings
    |-- [R] Investment gains/(losses): +$853M (2024); -$316M (2025).
    |-- [R] FY2025: operating income $1,468M; net income $1,231M.
    `-- [I] Track operations separately; retain accounting caveats.
|
[I] Claimed ecosystem loop is not identified causal evidence.
[I] Detail branches distinguish source-backed facts from seed gaps.
